_comment: Questions refused before any search. 'terms' are folded words (lower case, no accents) matched as whole words; 'phrases' are folded word sequences. Only words that are abusive in every context belong here: a subject (racism, pornography, antisemitism) is never a reason to refuse, since a reader may ask what the corpus says about it. The LLM judge, when configured, settles the rest.
